name: io.github.JohnBilousov/vocabit-mcp
title: Vocabit
description: Create flashcard sets in the Vocabit app and read back how the learner actually did.

environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Vocabit backend. Omit to run in demo mode with in-memory fixtures.

environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key sent as X-Agent-Key, issued by your Vocabit backend.

environmentVariables.name: VOCABIT_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Firebase UID of the learner. Optional; the backend has a default.
